description: Synthetic small-business operations chat: the outgoing operations lead hands over a product-launch workstream. Deadline, explicit decision later reversed, several owners, an unresolved question, a financial commitment, a task dependency and changed information. English. Pseudonymised and masked as stored by Baton (2026-11-20 AI recovery sprint).

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: Morning all. Starting this thread for the Diwali launch of the new tea gift boxes.

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: We decided to go with Kumar Packaging as the box supplier, they quoted the best price for 2,000 units.

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: Noted. The launch date is fixed for 25 October, the website listing has to be live by then.

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: [PERSON_3] will own the supplier relationship and track the delivery schedule from now on.

messages.author: [PERSON_3]
messages.body: Yes, I'll handle supplier follow-ups and the delivery tracking sheet.

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: We paid an advance of ₹45,000 to Kumar Packaging today, the balance ₹55,000 is due on delivery.

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: I'm responsible for the product photos and the website listing copy.

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: The photoshoot can only happen after the sample boxes arrive, so the listing depends on the supplier sending samples.

messages.author: [PERSON_4]
messages.body: Who is going to approve the final price of the gift box? We still haven't decided between ₹899 and ₹999.

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: [PERSON_4] will handle customer support emails during the launch week.

messages.author: [PERSON_3]
messages.body: Update: Kumar Packaging can't deliver before 28 October because of a strike at their plant.

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: Change of plan: we are switching the box supplier to Sri Lakshmi Boxes, they can deliver by 18 October. The Kumar advance will be refunded.

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: ok, I'll book the photographer for 20 October once the new samples arrive

messages.author: [PERSON_4]
messages.body: Still no answer on the gift box price, please someone decide before the listing goes live.
